entities.name: Radio Link Failure Detection
entities.description: Procedure for detecting radio link failure conditions in source MCG, target PCell, and SCG during various scenarios including DAPS handover.

entities.name: T304
entities.description: Timer running during DAPS handover configuration.

entities.name: T310
entities.description: Timer whose expiry indicates radio link failure in source SpCell, PCell, or PSCell.

entities.name: T312
entities.description: Timer whose expiry indicates radio link failure in PCell or PSCell.

entities.name: DAPS bearer configured and T304 running
entities.description: Condition where DAPS bearer is configured and T304 timer is running.

entities.name: Random access problem indication from MAC
entities.description: Condition triggered by random access problem indication from MCG or SCG MAC.

entities.name: Maximum RLC retransmissions reached
entities.description: Condition triggered when RLC indicates maximum number of retransmissions has been reached.

entities.name: Consistent uplink LBT failure indication
entities.description: Condition triggered by consistent uplink LBT failure indication from MAC.

entities.name: Source RLF detected
entities.description: Property indicating radio link failure is detected for the source MCG.

entities.name: MCG RLF detected
entities.description: Property indicating radio link failure is detected for the MCG.

entities.name: SCG RLF detected
entities.description: Property indicating radio link failure is detected for the SCG.

entities.name: Connection Re-establishment Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated upon radio link failure detection to re-establish connection.

entities.name: Failure Information Procedure
entities.description: Procedure to report RLC failure when CA duplication is configured and activated.

relations.description: RLF detection procedure requires DAPS bearer to be configured and T304 running for source MCG failure scenarios.
T310 expiry in source SpCell establishes source RLF detection.
T310 expiry in PCell establishes MCG RLF detection.
T312 expiry in PCell establishes MCG RLF detection.
Random access problem indication from MCG MAC establishes MCG RLF detection.
RLC maximum retransmissions indication establishes MCG RLF detection.
Consistent uplink LBT failure indication establishes MCG RLF detection.
MCG RLF detection starts connection re-establishment procedure.
RLC maximum retransmissions with CA duplication configuration starts failure information procedure.
T310 expiry in PSCell establishes SCG RLF detection.
T312 expiry in PSCell establishes SCG RLF detection.
SCG RLF detection starts connection re-establishment procedure.
